sessions.title: Build the Foundation

blocks.title: Skill — Trap Bar Technique
blocks.note: These sets don't count toward your working sets — they're technique practice.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.focus: Brace before every rep. Push the floor away. Finish with your glutes, not your lower back. Control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.focus: Every rep should look identical. If rep 5 doesn't look like rep 1, the weight is too heavy.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Pause for one second at the top of every rep.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.focus: If balance is the limiting factor, reduce the weight rather than shortening the stride.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Shoulders down. No rushing.

items.name: Assault Bike
items.focus: Aim for consistent effort across all rounds.

questions: How did you feel 2–3 hours later — energy and soreness, aside from the back?

sessions.title: Upper Strength + Athletic Control
sessions.goal: Build strength, improve shoulder control, train single-leg stability, and get movement through the back without adding more spinal loading.
sessions.success: Leave feeling better than when you arrived.

blocks.title: Readiness + Movement Check
blocks.note: Does the back loosen as you move, stay the same, or get sharper? If it loosens, continue.

items.name: World's Greatest Stretch
items.focus: Long spine. Rotate through upper back. Don't force range.

items.name: Dead Bug
items.focus: Ribs down. Slow breathing. Pelvis stable.

items.name: Scapular Wall Slides
items.focus: Smooth movement. Compare left vs right shoulder.

items.name: Passive Hang
items.focus: Do not force. Just create space through the shoulder.

blocks.title: Skill — Handstand Progression
blocks.note: Today's goal is not strength. It's better shoulder position and body awareness.

items.name: Wall Pike Hold
items.focus: Push the ground away. Shoulders active. Head neutral. Ribs tucked.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.focus: Shoulder blades stable. Controlled lowering. Smooth reps.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Pull elbows back. Pause at top. Don't shrug.
exercises.note: Yesterday's 17.5 kg was RPE 9. Today we build quality.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.focus: Front foot planted. Controlled descent. Drive through whole foot.
exercises.note: Only add weight if there's no hamstring cramping, the pelvis is stable, and movement stays smooth.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Press
exercises.focus: Glute engaged on kneeling side. Resist rotation. Smooth press.

items.name: Bike Intervals
items.focus: Hard = 8/10 effort. Do not sprint. The goal is consistent output.

questions: Did the left shoulder still feel restricted?
Did hamstring cramping appear during the split squats?

sessions.title: Single-Leg Strength + Posterior Chain
sessions.goal: Build single-leg strength without provoking the hamstring cramping, develop functional posterior-chain strength, train core stability, continue GST/handstand skill, and get a solid cardiovascular stimulus.
sessions.success: Finish feeling better than you started.

blocks.title: Readiness + Movement Check
blocks.note: Pay particular attention to your lower back. If it feels like normal muscular soreness and improves as you move, proceed.

items.name: Deep Squat Hold
items.focus: Use whatever assistance you need. Working gradually toward sitting comfortably in a deep squat.

items.name: Wall Pike / Handstand Progression
items.focus: Active shoulders. Push the floor away. Ribs controlled. Don't chase range.

items.name: Passive Hang
items.focus: Note whether the left shoulder still feels restricted compared with the right.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.focus: Full foot planted. Knee tracks naturally. Controlled descent. Drive through the floor.
exercises.note: Your hamstrings cramped when you loaded the walking lunges, so we're deliberately rebuilding this pattern. If all three sets are completely comfortable, try 5 kg each hand on the final set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.focus: Teaching your hips to load the posterior chain while keeping the spine controlled.
exercises.note: Deliberately much lighter than your trap-bar work. If the lower back feels worse rather than better during the movement, stop and report it.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Farmer Carry
exercises.note: Different from your normal farmer carry — the offset load forces your trunk to resist lateral flexion.

blocks.title: Core
blocks.note: First small step toward the trunk strength that supports your GST goals.

items.name: Hollow Body Hold
items.focus: If this feels too difficult, use a tucked position.

blocks.title: Conditioning
blocks.note: You've already shown this protocol is challenging. Today is consistent output, not beating the previous session.

items.name: Bike Intervals
items.focus: Aim for roughly 8/10 on the hard intervals.

questions: Left shoulder — still restricted during the hangs?
